name: Dotokoi
source:
The protagonist was cursed on his first day of high school!
The curse in question lowers the "resolution" the protagonist sees pretty girls in, so he sees nothing but pixels.
As the girls affection for him improves so does their "image quality".

[Translated from official website]
translation:
主角上高中第一天就被诅咒了！
该诅咒降低了主角看到漂亮女孩的“分辨率”，所以他只能看到像素。
随着女孩们对他的好感度的提高，她们的“形象质量”也随之提高。

【译自官网】
